title: An 85 year old female requires removal of a mandibular right lateral incisor due to severe periodontal disease. painanx: Inferior alveolar nerve block and nasopalatine nerve block.
quiz: Buccal infiltration and lingual infiltration at site #26.
column5: Right and Left Mental nerve blocks.
